Training.title: Quick Farming Tips
Training.noTipsFound: No tips found matching your search.
Training.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this training video tutorial?

tip6.title: Weaning Age for Smallholders
tip6.content: Wean piglets at 28 to 35 days instead of earlier. This allows piglets to grow stronger and adapt to solid feed using simple farm resources.

tip7.title: Gradual Separation Method
tip7.content: Reduce weaning stress by moving the sow out of the farrowing pen and leaving the piglets in their familiar environment for the first week.

tip8.title: Draft Prevention for Weaners
tip8.content: Block cold winds in the nursery pen by installing temporary curtains or wooden boards up to piglet-height (about 50cm).

tip11.title: Homemade Rehydration Solution
tip11.content: Feed a cheap, homemade electrolyte solution (5 tablespoons sugar, 1/2 tablespoon salt in 5 liters clean water) during the first 3 days of weaning to combat stress.

tip17.title: Clay Soil Mineral Supplement
tip17.content: Put a clean shovel of fresh, red clay soil (from a clean area) in the farrowing/weaning pen. Piglets eat it to get natural iron and minerals.

tip20.title: Agricultural Byproduct Boiling
tip20.content: Boil agricultural byproducts like yam peels, cassava peels, and potato vines to destroy natural toxins and improve digestibility.

tip21.title: Local Protein Sources
tip21.content: Supplement commercial feed by growing high-protein forage crops like Moringa, Azolla, or sweet potato leaves on the farm.

tip22.title: Gestation Feed Restriction
tip22.content: Limit gestating sows to 2-2.5 kg of feed per day to prevent them from becoming overweight, which causes difficult births.

tip26.title: Boiling Kitchen Waste
tip26.content: Boil hotel or kitchen food waste for 30 minutes to destroy African Swine Fever and Foot-and-Mouth disease viruses.

tip28.title: Charcoal for Digestion
tip28.content: Place small pieces of wood charcoal in grower pens. Pigs chew it to help bind stomach toxins and reduce diarrhea.

tip34.title: Hand Mating in Breeding Pen
tip34.content: Bring the sow in heat to the boar's pen for breeding, rather than letting the boar run loose in the sow herd.

tip35.title: Standing Heat Response
tip35.content: Test for heat by pressing your hands firmly on the sow's back; if she stands completely still and stiffens her ears, she is ready to mate.

tip39.title: DIY Crushed Piglet Protection
tip39.content: Install "guard rails" (heavy wooden poles or metal pipes placed 20cm out from the walls and 20cm off the floor) in farrowing pens.

tip43.title: Breeding Records Calendar
tip43.content: Mark the breeding date on a calendar; pregnancy lasts 114 days (3 months, 3 weeks, 3 days), allowing you to prepare the farrowing pen.

tip47.title: Gilt First Mating Age
tip47.content: Wait until a gilt is at least 8 months old and on her second or third heat cycle before mating her to ensure a larger first litter.

tip48.title: Isolation of New Purchases
tip48.content: Keep newly purchased pigs in a separate pen at least 20 meters away from your main herd for 30 days to check for sickness.

tip49.title: DIY Footbath Setup
tip49.content: Place a shallow plastic tub or half-cut tire filled with water and disinfectant (like chlorine or agricultural lime) at the farm gate.

tip51.title: Visitor Restriction Policy
tip51.content: Do not allow visitors (especially other pig buyers or farmers) inside your pig pens. Discuss business outside the pen area.

tip55.title: Natural Parasite Control
tip55.content: Feed crushed papaya seeds or pumpkin seeds to grower pigs as a cheap, natural remedy to help reduce internal worms.

tip60.title: Proper Burial of Mortalities
tip60.content: Bury dead pigs at least 2 meters deep, far away from water sources, and cover the carcass with agricultural lime before refilling the soil.

tip61.title: Low-Cost Pen Space
tip61.content: Provide at least 1 square meter of space per finisher pig to reduce fighting, stress, and skin lesions.

tip62.title: Natural Cross-Ventilation
tip62.content: Design pig houses with open sides (using wire mesh or bamboo slats) to allow natural breeze to blow through and remove odors.

tip75.title: DIY Compost Piles
tip75.content: Pile pig manure in a designated dry corner, cover it with banana leaves or plastic, and turn it weekly with a shovel to make compost.

tip76.title: Flexible Bag Biogas
tip76.content: Install a simple, low-cost plastic tubular biogas digester to treat pig manure, producing free cooking gas for the household.

tip92.title: Castration Age Limit
tip92.content: Castrate male piglets before they are 7 days old. At this age, the procedure is fast, heals quickly, and causes minimal pain.

tip94.title: Simple Notebook Records
tip94.content: Keep a small, cheap notebook in the barn to write down breeding dates, farrowing dates, and treatments for each sow.

dis_fmd.name: Indwara Yamaguru n umunwa (FMD)
dis_fmd.description: Indwara ya virusi itera ibisebe ku munwa no ku birenge.

dis_erysipelas.name: Ingurube Erysipelas
dis_erysipelas.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ibikomere bitandukanye byuruhu na artrite.

dis_csf.name: Indwara y'ingurube ya kera
dis_csf.description: Indwara zandura cyane virusi isa na ASF.
dis_csf.prevention: Inkingo hamwe no kubungabunga umutekano muke.

dis_anthrax.name: Anthrax
dis_anthrax.description: Indwara ikomeye ya bagiteri ishobora gufata abantu.

dis_brucellosis.name: Brucellose
dis_brucellosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera kunanirwa kubyara.

dis_coccidiosis.name: Coccidiose
dis_coccidiosis.description: Indwara ya parasitike yibasira cyane cyane ingurube.

dis_pneumonia.name: Umusonga wa Mycoplasmal
dis_pneumonia.description: Indwara zubuhumekero zidakira zitera gukura nabi.

dis_salmonellosis.name: Salmonellose
dis_salmonellosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ibibazo bikomeye byo munda.

dis_ppv.name: Porcine Parvovirus (PPV)
dis_ppv.description: Impamvu zisanzwe zitera kunanirwa kwimyororokere muri gilts.

dis_leptospirosis.name: Leptospirose
dis_leptospirosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri ya Zoonotic yibasira impyiko.

dis_edema.name: Indwara
dis_edema.description: Biterwa n'uburozi bwa E. coli mu ngurube zonsa.

dis_mange.name: Sarcoptic Mange
dis_mange.description: Indwara y'uruhu rwa parasitike itera kubura amahwemo bikabije.

dis_anemia.name: Kubura fer
dis_anemia.description: Bikunze kugaragara mu ngurube zo mu nzu nta byongeweho ibyuma.

dis_ulcers.name: Indwara yo mu gifu
dis_ulcers.description: Biterwa no kugaburira neza cyangwa guhangayika.

dis_pss.name: Indwara ya Porcine
dis_pss.description: Imiterere ya genetike iterwa no guhangayika.

dis_tge.name: Indwara ya Gastroenteritis (TGE)
dis_tge.description: Indwara ya virusi hamwe nimpfu nyinshi mu ngurube zikiri nto.

dis_greasy_pig.name: Indwara y'ingurube
dis_greasy_pig.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera uruhu rwamavuta.

dis_pseudorabies.name: Pseudorabies (Aujeszky's)
dis_pseudorabies.description: Indwara ya virusi yibasira sisitemu y'imitsi n'ubuhumekero.
dis_pseudorabies.prevention: Gahunda yo gukingira no kurandura burundu.

dis_ped.name: Indwara y'impiswi y'icyorezo (PED)
dis_ped.description: Bisa na TGE, byica cyane kuri neonates.

dis_rabies.name: Indwara
dis_rabies.description: Indwara yica virusi mubisanzwe ituruka kurumwa.

dis_pox.name: Ingurube
dis_pox.description: Indwara y'uruhu rwa virusi, ikwirakwizwa n'indwara.

dis_vs.name: Vesicular Stomatitis
dis_vs.prevention: Kurwanya udukoko no gushyira mu kato.

dis_clostridial.name: Indwara ya Clostridial Enteritis
dis_clostridial.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera kwangirika gukabije.

dis_glassers.name: Indwara y'Ibirahure
dis_glassers.description: Bitera gutwika ibibyimba bikikije umutima, ibihaha, ingingo.

dis_ileitis.name: Ileitis (Lawsonia)
dis_ileitis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri yo mu mara mato.

dis_tetanus.name: Tetanusi
dis_tetanus.description: Uburozi bwa bagiteri bugira ingaruka kuri sisitemu y'imitsi.

dis_rickets.name: Riketi
dis_rickets.description: Kubura imirire bigira ingaruka kumikurire yamagufwa.

dis_salt_poisoning.name: Uburozi bwumunyu
dis_salt_poisoning.description: Biterwa no kubura amazi bikurikirwa no kunywa cyane.

dis_heat_stroke.name: Ubushuhe
dis_heat_stroke.description: Ubushyuhe bukabije kubera guhumeka nabi cyangwa igicucu.

dis_rectal_prolapse.name: Kurimbuka
dis_rectal_prolapse.description: Akenshi ikurikira inkorora, impiswi, cyangwa imihangayiko ikonje.

dis_splayleg.name: Splayleg
dis_splayleg.description: Ingurube zavutse zidashobora kwihagararaho n'amaguru y'inyuma.

dis_vulvovaginitis.name: Vulvovaginitis
dis_vulvovaginitis.description: Biterwa n'uburozi bwa estrogeneque fungal mu biryo.

dis_melioidosis.name: Melioidose
dis_melioidosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri ituruka ku butaka / amazi.

dis_trypanosomiasis.name: Trypanosomiasis
dis_trypanosomiasis.description: Indwara ya Protozoan ikwirakwizwa nisazi ya tsetse.

dis_cysticercosis.name: Cysticercose
dis_cysticercosis.description: Intambwe nini ya tapeworm yabantu mumitsi yingurube.

dis_listeriosis.name: Urutonde
dis_listeriosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri ya sisitemu y'imitsi.

dis_ear_necrosis.name: Amatwi ya Necrosis
dis_ear_necrosis.description: Akenshi biterwa no guhangayika, ubucucike bwinshi, cyangwa kwandura.
dis_ear_necrosis.prevention: Mugabanye ubucucike no kuvura ubwandu bwa kabiri.

dis_sunburn.name: Izuba Rirashe
dis_sunburn.description: Ifata ingurube zifite uruhu rwera hanze.

dis_navel_ill.name: Indwara
dis_navel_ill.prevention: Iyode yibiza mugihe cyo kuvuka no kugira isuku.

dis_iron_toxicity.name: Uburozi bw'icyuma
dis_iron_toxicity.description: Irashobora kubaho mugihe icyuma cyatewe muri Vit E ibuze ingurube.
dis_iron_toxicity.prevention: Menya neza ko imirire yo kubiba iringaniye.

dis_aflatoxicosis.name: Aflatoxicose
dis_aflatoxicosis.description: Uburozi bwuburozi buturuka ku ngano zumye cyangwa ibiryo bitera umwijima na jaundice.
dis_aflatoxicosis.prevention: Irinde kugaburira ibiryo byoroshye, kubika ibinyampeke mugihe cyumye, kandi ukoreshe uburozi.

dis_parakeratosis.name: Parakeratose (Kubura Zinc)
dis_parakeratosis.description: Indwara yintungamubiri itera igikomere gikabije, igikomere cyuruhu.
dis_parakeratosis.prevention: Menya neza igipimo cya calcium-kuri-zinc mu biryo kandi utange inyongera ya zinc.

dis_biotin_deficiency.name: Kubura Biotine
dis_biotin_deficiency.description: Kubura imirire bitera ibinono byacitse, ibikomere byuruhu, no gucumbagira.
dis_biotin_deficiency.prevention: Ongeraho indyo hamwe na biotine kandi wirinde hasi ya beto itose.

dis_gossypol_toxicity.name: Uburozi bwa Gossypol
dis_gossypol_toxicity.description: Uburozi bwo kugaburira ibiryo bibisi cyangwa birenze urugero, bitera ibibazo byubuhumekero.
dis_gossypol_toxicity.prevention: Mugabanye ifunguro ryimbuto mumirire kandi ukoreshe sulfate yicyuma kugirango ubuze gossypol.

dis_cassava_poisoning.name: Uburozi bw'imyumbati
dis_cassava_poisoning.description: Uburozi bwa Cyanide buturuka kumizi cyangwa imyumbati yatunganijwe neza.
dis_cassava_poisoning.prevention: Kuramo, guteka, izuba-ryumye, cyangwa imyumbati ya ferment mbere yo kugaburira.

dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.name: Uburozi bw'Ibijumba
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.description: Uburozi buturuka ku birayi biryoshye, bitera uburwayi bukomeye bwo guhumeka.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.prevention: Kureka ibirayi byangiritse cyangwa byumye; kugaburira ibirayi gusa.

dis_mma.name: Nyuma yo kubyara Dysgalactia (MMA)
dis_mma.description: Mastitis, metritis, na agalactia itera umuriro no kubura amata mu mbuto nyuma yo guhinga.
dis_mma.prevention: Komeza kugira isuku yikaramu ikarishye kandi urebe neza imirire ihagije.

dis_pwd.name: Indwara y'impiswi nyuma yo konka (PWD)
dis_pwd.description: Impiswi ya bagiteri mu ngurube nyuma gato yo konka, itera umwuma.
dis_pwd.prevention: Mugabanye guhagarika umutima, kubungabunga isuku nyinshi, no gutanga amazi meza yo kunywa.

dis_trichinellosis.name: Trichinellose
dis_trichinellosis.description: Indwara ya parasitike ya Zoonotic ituruka ku kurya inyama mbisi, bigatuma imitsi ikomera.
dis_trichinellosis.prevention: Ntugaburire ibishishwa bibisi, guteka ibiryo by'iminota 30, no kugenzura imbeba.

dis_hydatid_disease.name: Hydatidose
dis_hydatid_disease.description: Indwara ya parasitike itera sisitemu yuzuye amazi mu ngingo.
dis_hydatid_disease.prevention: Kwangiza imbwa zihinga kandi zikababuza kurya ingingo zingurube.

dis_phe.name: Porcine Hemorrhagic Enteropathie
dis_phe.description: Impiswi ikabije yamaraso nimpfu zitunguranye mubuhinzi / barangiza ingurube.
dis_phe.prevention: Komeza kugira isuku nziza kandi ukoreshe antibiyotike ikwiye iyobowe nubuvuzi.

dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.name: Indwara ya Mycoplasmal
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ingingo kubyimba, gucumbagira, no gucika intege.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.prevention: Kunoza imiturire, kugabanya ubwinshi bwimigabane, no kuvura hakiri kare.

dis_foot_rot.name: Kubora ibirenge (Necrobacillose)
dis_foot_rot.description: Indwara ya bagiteri yinjira mu gikomere, itera kubora no gucumbagira.
dis_foot_rot.prevention: Gusana beto ikaze, komeza hasi, kandi ukoreshe ubwogero bwamaguru nibikenewe.

dis_babesiosis.name: Indwara iterwa na Babesiose
dis_babesiosis.description: Amaraso yanduye parasite itera umuriro mwinshi, kubura amaraso, ninkari zijimye.
dis_babesiosis.prevention: Kugenzura amatiku ukoresheje acariside kandi ukomeze amakaramu adafite ibimera.

dis_anaplasmosis.name: Anaplasmose
dis_anaplasmosis.description: Indwara ya bagiteri yanduye itera amaraso make, umuriro, na jaundice.
dis_anaplasmosis.prevention: Shyira mubikorwa gahunda yo kugenzura no kugenzura amatiku.

dis_sow_hysteria.name: Kubiba Hysteria
dis_sow_hysteria.description: Imyitwarire idahwitse aho kubiba bigatera ubukana no kuruma ingurube.
dis_sow_hysteria.prevention: Tanga ahantu hatuje hatuje, ugenzure gilts, kandi ukoreshe imiti igabanya ubukana.

dis_thorny_headed_worm.name: Inzoka ifite imitwe
dis_thorny_headed_worm.description: Inyo ya parasitike yabonetse mukurya inyenzi, bigatera gutobora amara.
dis_thorny_headed_worm.prevention: Irinde kurera kubuntu kubutaka bwatewe ninyenzi kandi ukoreshe ibyatsi.

dis_strongyloidiasis.name: Strongyloidiasis (Urudodo)
dis_strongyloidiasis.description: Inzoka zo munda zitera impiswi zikomeye nimpfu zingurube.
dis_strongyloidiasis.prevention: Komeza ibisanduku byumye byumye kandi bisukuye, kandi imbuto zinzoka mbere yo guhinga.

dis_hyostrongylosis.name: Inzoka itukura
dis_hyostrongylosis.description: Indwara yo mu gifu itera gastrite, kubura amaraso, no kugabanya ibiro.
dis_hyostrongylosis.prevention: Kuzenguruka urwuri, komeza amazu yumutse, kandi ushyire mubikorwa gahunda yo kwangiza.

dis_oesophagostomiasis.name: Indwara ya Nodular
dis_oesophagostomiasis.description: Parasite yo munda itera nodules mu rukuta rw'inda, biganisha ku mbuto zoroshye.
dis_oesophagostomiasis.prevention: Isuku yamakaramu isanzwe no gukoresha bisanzwe anthemmintics.

dis_fascioliasis.name: Fascioliasis (Fluke y'umwijima)
dis_fascioliasis.description: Indwara ya parasitike ifata umwijima, ikunze kugaragara mu rwuri rutose cyangwa ibishanga.
dis_fascioliasis.prevention: Irinde ingurube kurisha ahantu h'ibishanga no kugenzura ibyondo.

dis_emcv.name: Encephalomyocarditis (EMCV)
dis_emcv.description: Indwara iterwa na virusi itera kunanirwa k'umutima no gukuramo inda.
dis_emcv.prevention: Shyira mu bikorwa igenzura rikomeye kandi urinde ibiryo kwanduza.

dis_demodectic_mange.name: Demodex Mange
dis_demodectic_mange.description: Uruhu rwa microscopique mite itera ibibara binini na pustules.
dis_demodectic_mange.prevention: Kunoza imirire yubushyo, gutandukanya ingurube zanduye, no gukoresha acariside.

dis_pityriasis_rosea.name: Pityriasis Rosea
dis_pityriasis_rosea.description: Imiterere yuruhu itanduye mu ngurube zikiri nto zikora impeta.
dis_pityriasis_rosea.prevention: Mubisanzwe kwikemurira ibibazo; komeza ibitanda bisukuye, byumye kandi bigabanye imihangayiko.

dis_photosensitization.name: Kwifotora
dis_photosensitization.description: Gukomera kwizuba nkingurube zifite uruhu rworoshye nyuma yo kurya ibimera byihariye.
dis_photosensitization.prevention: Tanga igicucu, ukureho ibyatsi bibi, kandi ugumane ingurube mu nzu.

dis_shoulder_ulcers.name: Kubiba Ibisebe Byigitugu
dis_shoulder_ulcers.description: Ibisebe byumuvuduko ku bitugu byimbuto zoroshye zubatswe kuri beto ikomeye.
dis_shoulder_ulcers.prevention: Tanga uburiri bworoshye, komeza kubiba mumubiri mwiza, kandi ukoreshe materi.

dis_ear_biting.name: Amatwi yo kurya abantu
dis_ear_biting.description: Imyitwarire idasanzwe aho ingurube ziruma ugutwi kwa bagenzi bawe, bigatera necrosis.
dis_ear_biting.prevention: Mugabanye imbaga, utezimbere umwuka, kandi utange ubutunzi nkumunyururu.

dis_gastric_torsion.name: Gastric Torsion (Bloat)
dis_gastric_torsion.description: Kubyimba gutunguranye no kugoreka igifu, biganisha ku rupfu rwihuse.
dis_gastric_torsion.prevention: Irinde kugaburira amafunguro manini nyuma yo kwiyiriza ubusa no kugabanya ibiryo bya buri munsi mo ibice.

dis_c_difficile.name: Clostridium diffile (CDI)
dis_c_difficile.description: Indwara ya bagiteri mu ngurube zikivuka itera impiswi y'amazi no kubyimba.
dis_c_difficile.prevention: Sukura kandi wanduze amakaramu ya farrowing neza kandi urebe neza ko hakiri kare.

dis_cold_stress.name: Ubukonje bukabije (Hypothermia)
dis_cold_stress.description: Gukonjesha umubiri cyane mu ngurube, bigatera guhinda umushyitsi no gupfa cyane.
dis_cold_stress.prevention: Tanga amatara yubushyuhe, udusanduku twikaraga, kandi ukomeze ahantu hakeye kandi hatarimo umushinga.

dis_necrotic_enteritis.name: Indwara ya Necrotic
dis_necrotic_enteritis.description: Indwara yuburozi bwa bagiteri itera impiswi ikabije yamaraso nimpfu nyinshi zingurube.
dis_necrotic_enteritis.prevention: Gukingiza kubiba mbere yo guhunika no gukomeza isuku yikaramu yuzuye.

dis_navel_bleeding.name: Kuva amaraso
dis_navel_bleeding.description: Amaraso menshi ava mumatongo mu ngurube zikivuka.
dis_navel_bleeding.prevention: Ihambire umugozi ukivuka kandi wirinde kugaburira ibiryo byanduye mycotoxine kubiba.

dis_spirochetal_colitis.name: Porcine Spirochetal Colitis
dis_spirochetal_colitis.description: Indwara y'impiswi yoroheje mu gukura ingurube, itera kwiyongera nabi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis.prevention: Sukura inkono zigaburira kandi uvure ingurube zanduye hamwe na antibiotike.

dis_salmonella_septicemia.name: Salmonella Septicemia
dis_salmonella_septicemia.description: Indwara ikabije yamaraso salmonella itera uruhu rwumutuku nurupfu rwihuse.
dis_salmonella_septicemia.prevention: Gutandukanya ingurube zirwaye, kuvura amazi, no kubungabunga umutekano muke.

dis_prdc.name: Indwara y'ubuhumekero
dis_prdc.description: Indwara zifata imyanya y'ubuhumekero ya virusi na bagiteri itera inkorora no gukura nabi.
dis_prdc.prevention: Kunoza umwuka, irinde ubucucike, kandi ugenzure virusi yibanze.

dis_ergotism.name: Uburozi bwa Ergot (Ergotism)
dis_ergotism.description: Uburozi bwibihumyo biva mu binyampeke byanduye ergot, bigatera tissue necrosis.
dis_ergotism.prevention: Mugaburira ibiryo byumubiri kumubiri wijimye kandi usimbuze ibiryo byanduye.

dis_bvdv_pig.name: Indwara ya BVDV mu ngurube
dis_bvdv_pig.description: Indwara ya Bovine Virus Diarrhea kwandura kwandura inka, bigatera gukuramo inda.
dis_bvdv_pig.prevention: Komeza ingurube zitandukanye ninka nintama, kandi ugabanye guhuza amoko.

dis_endocarditis.name: Indwara ya bagiteri
dis_endocarditis.description: Indwara y'umutima itera kunanirwa k'umutima n'urupfu rutunguranye mugihe cy'amaganya.
dis_endocarditis.prevention: Wihutire kuvura ingingo-zirwaye n'ibikomere, hanyuma uhitemo kurwanya genetiki yanduye.

dis_polyserositis.name: Mycoplasma Polyserositis
dis_polyserositis.description: Fibrinous inflammation yibihaha, umutima, hamwe nubuso bufatanye mubonsa.
dis_polyserositis.prevention: Mugabanye guhangayika, wirinde kuvanga imyanda, kandi uhumeke neza.

dis_congenital_tremor.name: Kuvuka
dis_congenital_tremor.description: Imiterere ya Neurologiya mu ngurube zikivuka zitera guhinda umushyitsi.
dis_congenital_tremor.prevention: Irinde gukoresha amasohoro ava mu ngurube zanduye kandi ugabanye imbaraga zo kubiba mugihe cyo gutwita.

Symptoms.criticalBiosecurityDesc: High-confidence clinical match detected for legally notifiable disease: {disease} ({percent}% match).
Symptoms.emergencyContainmentProtocolSteps:
1. 🔒 Immediate Quarantine: Seal affected pen immediately; restrict personnel access.
2. 🚫 Movement Freeze: Cease all live pig, pork, feed, and manure shipments off-farm.
3. 🧼 Disinfect: Deploy boot baths & tyre dips with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda.
4. 📞 Mandatory Reporting: Contact your District Veterinary Officer immediately.
5. ⚠️ No Slaughter: Do not slaughter sick or suspect animals for meat.
Symptoms.bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
Symptoms.bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
Symptoms.bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
Symptoms.bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.content: By accessing and using SmartSwine app, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.content:
"SmartSwine" provides farm management tools including, but not limited to:
• Herd tracking and health data.
• Financial record keeping.
• Human Resource management.
• AI-assisted diagnostic suggestions.
• Market access information.

s3.title: 3. Data Privacy & Cloud Backup
s3.content:
You retain ownership of the data you input (herd data, financials, e.t.c.). 
Your farm data is stored securely using Google Firebase, while we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. 
By enabling Cloud Backup, you consent to the storage and synchronization of your data across your devices. 
We do not sell your personal or farm data to third parties.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the data entered. Incorrect data in the "Feed" or "Financials" modules may result in incorrect calculations.

s4.title: 4. No Medical or Veterinary Advice (Critical Disclaimer)
s4.content:
The "Feed Calculator", "Feed Formulator", "Symptoms Analyzer" and "Disease Finder" features are for educational and informational purposes only.
• The AI results are generated by algorithms and are not a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
• The User agrees to consult a licensed veterinarian before making any feeding and medical decisions regarding livestock.
• The App Owner is not liable for any livestock loss or damages resulting from the use of the app and its features.

s5.title: 5. User Responsibilities
s5.content: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.

s6.title: 6. Prohibited Conduct
s6.content:
Users agree not to:
• Use the app for any illegal purposes.
• Attempt to reverse engineer the application.
• Input fraudulent financial data for the purpose of deceiving third parties.

s7.title: 7. Service Availability
s7.content: We strive for 99% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access to the service. Data backups are provided as a convenience; however, users are encouraged to maintain their own records.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
s8.content: SmartSwine app is provided "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, its developers shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service, including livestock loss or financial discrepancies.

s9.title: 9. Financial Data
s9.content: The "Financials" module is a tracking tool and does not constitute professional accounting or tax advice. Users are encouraged to export their data for review by certified accountants.

s10.title: 10. Changes to Terms
s10.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the app constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

s11.title: 11. Contact Information
s11.content: For support or legal inquiries, please contact the developer through the app's profile settings or at bibiniitech@gmail.com.

Guide.guide_breeding_step1_desc: Shakisha reflex ihagaze, kubyimba kubyimba, hamwe nijwi. Andika serivisi karemano cyangwa AI hamwe nibisobanuro birambuye.
Guide.guide_breeding_step1_tip: Imyitozo myiza ni ugukorera imbuto kabiri: amasaha 12 atandukanye mugihe cy'ubushyuhe buhagaze.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine ihita iteganya gusubiramo ubushyuhe muminsi 18-24 no kumenyesha kure iminsi 110-114.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_tip: Reba gusubira mu bushyuhe hafi yumunsi wa 21. Niba kubiba byerekana ubushyuhe buhagaze, ongera ukore ako kanya.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_desc: Kurandura ibisanduku bya farrowing hanyuma wimure imbuto zitwite iminsi 4 kugeza 5 mbere yigihe giteganijwe. Tegura amatara yubushyuhe yingurube.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_tip: Komeza ahantu h'ingurube hashyushye (30-32 ° C) kugirango wirinde hypothermia kubana bavutse.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Yavutse ari muzima, Abana bavutse, Mummies, hamwe nuburemere bwuzuye bwo kuvuka kugirango dusuzume imbuto zababyeyi.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_tip: Koresha inshinge zicyuma no gukuramo amenyo y'urushinge mumasaha 24-48 uhereye kure.
Guide.guide_breeding_subtitle: Kurikirana kubiba ubushyuhe, gutanga amatariki, gusama iminsi 114, hamwe na litiro.
Guide.guide_feed_step1_desc: Jya kuri 'Kugaburira' hanyuma ufungure igikoresho cya 'Kugaburira ibiryo' kugirango ukore cyangwa uhindure ibiryo byagabanijwe.
Guide.guide_feed_step1_tip: Reba ibiciro byisoko ryibanze mbere kugirango umenye proteine ​​zihenze cyane nisoko ryingufu.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_desc: Hitamo intego y'ingurube (Creep, Starter, Grower, Finisher, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) kugirango ushiremo intungamubiri zisanzwe.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_tip: Ingurube zikura zisaba proteine nyinshi (16-18%) kuruta gutera inda (12-14%).
Guide.guide_feed_step3_desc: Ongeramo ibirungo nkibigori, Ifunguro rya Soya, Ingano yingano, Fishmeal, na Premix. Kuringaniza ijanisha kugeza utubari twintungamubiri duhindutse icyatsi.
Guide.guide_feed_step3_tip: Menya neza ko Kalisiyumu igereranije na Fosifore (Ca: P) iguma hagati ya 1.2: 1 na 1.6: 1 kugirango amagufwa akure neza.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_desc: Bika uburyo bwawe bwuzuye kugirango ubone uburyo bwihuse, cyangwa wandike icyiciro kivanze kugirango uhite uvugurura ibiryo.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_tip: Kuvanga ibiryo mubice bimwe hanyuma ubike muri pallet yumye, hejuru kugirango wirinde aflatoxine no kwangirika.
Guide.guide_feed_subtitle: Shushanya ibiciro-byuzuye, byuzuye byuzuye indyo yuzuye kuri buri cyiciro.
Guide.guide_finances_step1_desc: Andika amafaranga yose yakoreshejwe mu murima ashyirwa mu byiciro na Feed, Veterinari, Umurimo, Ibikorwa, no Kubungabunga.
Guide.guide_finances_step1_tip: Andika amafaranga akimara kugura bibaye bityo gusesengura ibiciro bigume bigezweho.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_desc: Andika amafaranga avuye kugurisha amatungo mazima, imirambo yabagiwe, ubworozi, cyangwa ifumbire mvaruganda.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_tip: Andika uburemere bwuzuye nigiciro cyanyuma kuri kg kugirango ukurikirane isoko ryagaragaye.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_desc: Ongera usuzume COP kuri kg hamwe na Finisher Breakeven igiciro kugirango buri gikorwa gitange inyungu nziza.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_tip: Ibiryo bigomba kwerekana neza 65-75% yikiguzi cyawe cyose. Mugabanye gusesagura ibiryo.
Guide.guide_finances_subtitle: Kurikirana amafaranga yakoreshejwe, kugurisha, no kubara ikiguzi cy'umusaruro kuri kg.
Guide.guide_health_step1_desc: Koresha igikoresho cyo gushakisha indwara kugirango uhuze ibimenyetso byubuvuzi byagaragaye (inkorora, impiswi, ibikomere) hamwe ningurube zisanzwe.
Guide.guide_health_step1_tip: Tandukanya inyamaswa zirwaye ako kanya mu kiraro cya karantine mbere yo gutangira kuvurwa.
Guide.guide_health_step2_desc: Andika imiti ya antibiotique cyangwa antiparasitike kandi wandike neza iminsi yo gukuramo inyama.
Guide.guide_health_step2_tip: Ntuzigere ucuruza cyangwa kubaga itungo mbere yuko idirishya ryuzuye ryo gukuramo inyama rirangira.
Guide.guide_health_step3_desc: Komeza ibyogero byamaguru hamwe na disinfectant, kugenzura abasura imirima, gusukura ibinyabiziga, no guha akato ibigega bishya muminsi 30.
Guide.guide_health_step3_tip: Biosecurity ihendutse inshuro 10 kuruta kuvura icyorezo cyindwara.
Guide.guide_health_subtitle: Menya ibimenyetso, ukurikize protocole yubuvuzi, kandi ukomeze umutekano muke.
Guide.guide_herd_step1_desc: Injira 'Ubushyo bwamakuru' uhereye kumurongo wibanze cyangwa ibishushanyo kugirango urebe ibyanditswe byose byubushyo.
Guide.guide_herd_step1_tip: Urashobora gushungura inyandiko zubushyo kumiterere (Igikorwa, Igurishwa, Cull) ukoresheje imiterere ya tabs.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_desc: Kanda buto '+' ireremba. Uzuza amakuru y'ingenzi: Ikirangantego, Ubwoko, Igitsina, Itariki y'amavuko, n'ikaramu.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_tip: Shinga indangamuntu zisobanutse, zisanzwe (urugero, SOW-001, BOAR-01) kugirango byoroshye gukurikirana umurima.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_desc: Fungura ikarita yerekana umwirondoro winyamanswa kugirango wandike ibipimo bisanzwe, inkingo, kurwara, cyangwa kwivuza.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_tip: Gupima bisanzwe bifasha kubara neza Impuzandengo Yunguka ya buri munsi (ADG) no kumenya indwara hakiri kare.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_desc: Itsinda rikura ingurube mu makaramu yagenewe cyangwa mu matsinda kugira ngo ukurikirane neza ubwinshi bw'ikaramu no kugaburira ibiryo.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_tip: Irinde amakaramu yuzuye kugira ngo wirinde imyitwarire yo kuruma kandi urebe neza ko inyamaswa zikura.
Guide.guide_herd_subtitle: Andika inyamaswa, ucunge amatwi, utange amakaramu, kandi ukurikirane umurongo.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_desc: Iyandikishe abakozi, abashinzwe imirima, hamwe nabaveterineri bafite uruhushya rwihariye rwo kwinjira.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_tip: Kubuza uburyo bwamafaranga kubayobozi naba bayobozi bikomeza inyandiko zumutekano.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_desc: Tanga gahunda za buri munsi nko kugaburira ikaramu, gusukura amazi, amasaha ya kure, no kumenya ubushyuhe.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_tip: Kugenzura urutonde rwibikorwa birinda ibiryo byabuze cyangwa gutinda kumiti.
Guide.guide_hr_step3_desc: Andika umushahara, ibihembo, hamwe nogukata kugirango ukomeze amateka yimishahara iboneye.
Guide.guide_hr_step3_tip: Buri gihe shyiramo inyandiko zerekana ibihembo cyangwa avansi yimishahara kugirango igenzurwe neza.
Guide.guide_hr_subtitle: Gucunga abakozi, kugenera imirimo ya buri munsi, gukurikirana abitabira, no guhemba umushahara.
Guide.guide_intro_desc: Intambwe ku yindi ibikorwa byoguhuza ibikorwa kugirango byorohereze ubuzima bwubushyo, kugaburira ibiryo, ukwezi kwororoka, imari, no gucunga abakozi.
Guide.guide_intro_title: Menya Ingurube Yawe hamwe na SmartSwine
Guide.guide_offline_step1_desc: Andika inyamaswa zongeweho, ibiti byo kugaburira, serivisi zororoka, hamwe nubuvuzi nubwo nta Wi-Fi cyangwa ibimenyetso bya selile.
Guide.guide_offline_step1_tip: Impinduka zose zabitswe mugace kubikoresho byawe bifite umutekano byububiko.
Guide.guide_offline_step2_desc: Iyo umurongo wa enterineti ugaruwe, ivugurura rya interineti ryose rihita rihuza nububiko bwibicu.
Guide.guide_offline_step2_tip: Reba ibendera rya interineti hejuru ya ecran kugirango umenye uko uhagaze ubu.
Guide.guide_offline_subtitle: Kora udafite interineti mu ikaramu ya kure; guhuza mu buryo bwikora iyo wongeye guhura.
Guide.guide_search_placeholder: Shakisha ingingo, imirimo, cyangwa ibikorwa byakazi ...
Guide.guide_weight_step1_desc: Mugihe umunzani utaboneka, bapima umutima wumutima inyuma yamaguru yimbere nuburebure kuva kumatwi kugeza kumurizo.
Guide.guide_weight_step1_tip: Komeza kaseti yo gupima ifata uruhu rwingurube utiriwe ukanda inyama.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_desc: SmartSwine ibara ADG hagati yuburemere kugirango ikurikirane inzira yo gukura ikurikije ibipimo bisanzwe.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_tip: Intego ADG kubahinzi mubucuruzi ni 650g - 850g / kumunsi munsi yimirire myiza.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_desc: Reba itariki iteganijwe kubagwa isoko (intego 90-100kg) kugirango utegure ingengo yimari yo kugaburira no kugurisha ibicuruzwa byabaguzi.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_tip: Tegura kugurisha kwawe mbere yo gufunga amasezerano meza yabaguzi.
Guide.guide_weight_subtitle: Gereranya uburemere bw'ingurube, ukurikirane umuvuduko wo gukura, hamwe n'amatariki yo kubaga.
